bio: Derek Scott Merrin (born January 4, 1986) is an American politician who previously served as the state representative for the 42nd District of the Ohio House of Representatives. He was the Republican nominee for Ohio's 9th congressional district in 2024, where he was narrowly defeated by incumbent Marcy Kaptur. Merrin was the Republican nominee in Ohio's 9th district in the 2026 election, again losing to Kaptur.

items.t: Passed a tax break for prescription eyeglasses and contact lenses (2017).
items.q: In September 2017, Merrin passed a tax break for prescription eyeglasses and contact lenses.

items.t: Proposed House Bill 101, the Epinephrine Accessibility Act, signed into law in 2019, allowing pharmacists to substitute generic epinephrine auto-injectors for brand-name ones.
items.q: The law allows pharmacists to substitute a brand-name epinephrine auto-injector with a pharmaceutically equivalent generic one.

items.t: Introduced an amendment placing authority over lead-safety regulations with the Ohio Department of Health, preempting local rental housing ordinances such as Toledo's (2017).
items.q: he introduced an amendment that would place authority over lead-safety regulations with the Ohio Department of Health, preempting local lead-safety rental housing ordinances such as Toledo's.

items.t: Introduced legislation counting weekends and holidays toward the three-day notice period required before eviction proceedings; it did not advance out of committee (2017).
items.q: legislation that year that would count weekends and holidays as part of the three-day notice period required before a landlord can begin eviction proceedings
